Container.Name: brscan-skey
Container.Overview: Press SCAN → Scan to PC on a Brother network scanner and get a multi-page PDF in a folder, such as the Paperless-ngx consume folder or a share. Useful on models without a Scan to FTP / Network menu (many North American models). The container runs Brother's brscan-skey daemon. It takes every page in the document feeder (or the glass when the feeder is empty) and writes compact PDFs atomically, owned by nobody:users by default. REQUIREMENTS: host networking (already set), and on the device web page Network → Network → Protocol → SNMP → "SNMP v1/v2c read-write access". Otherwise the device shows "No PC found". If you set a custom Set community there, enter it below. amd64 only (Brother ships x86 drivers only). To list supported models: docker run --rm --entrypoint list-models devzwf/brscan-skey
Container.DonateText: This container is made and maintained by me. If it saves you some time, you can support my work here
Container.Requires: On the Brother device: SNMP v1/v2c read-write access must be enabled (Network → Network → Protocol → SNMP).

Config.Name: Output folder
Config.Description: Folder where the PDFs are written, for example the Paperless-ngx consume folder.

Config.Name: Scanner IP
Config.Description: IP address of the Brother device. Use a static lease.

Config.Name: Scanner model
Config.Description: Exact model name, e.g. DCP-L2550DW, MFC-L2710DW, HL-L2395DW. The container refuses to start with an unsupported model.

Config.Name: Name shown on the device
Config.Description: Name of this PC in the Scan to PC menu of the device.

Config.Name: Page size
Config.Description: Scan area: Letter, A4 or Legal.

Config.Name: Scan mode
Config.Description: Colour mode. The available values depend on the model.

Config.Name: Time Zone
Config.Description: Time zone, used for file names and logs.

Config.Name: SNMP write community
Config.Description: Must match the Set community on the device (Brother default: internal).

Config.Name: JPEG quality
Config.Description: JPEG quality inside the PDF (gray and colour).

Config.Name: Scan width (mm)
Config.Description: Optional custom width; overrides Page size. Max usually 211.9.

Config.Name: Scan height (mm)
Config.Description: Optional custom height; overrides Page size.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Owner of the created files (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group of the created files (100 = users).
